Anguilla Acts and Regulations (Printing of False Copies) Act R.S.A. c. A20
ACTS AND REGULATIONS (PRINTING OF FALSE COPIES) ACT
Penalty for printing false copies
1. Any person who—
(a) prints any paper which falsely purports to be a copy of an Act or regulation; or
(b) tenders in evidence any such paper falsely purporting to be a copy of an Act or
regulation knowing the same to be false;
is guilty of an offence and on conviction is liable to be imprisoned for a term of 2 years.
Citation
2. This Act may be cited as the Acts and Regulations (Printing of False Copies) Act, Revised
Statutes of Anguilla, Chapter A20.
